# The Back Bencher Show

The Back Bencher Show is a spontaneous and interactive crowd-work
comedy show in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Show

The show features four comedians:
- Pawan Bhatia
- Ramdas
- Subhag
- Abhishake

The comedy includes clean, family-friendly, observational,
relatable, opinionated and sarcastic comedy.

The defining feature of the show is spontaneous crowd interaction.
The audience can influence the direction of the comedy, making
each performance different.

## Schedule

Every Saturday
9:00 PM
Duration: 90 minutes

## Venue

Flow Comedy Club
Aundh, Pune, Maharashtra 411007, India
